observations: Three photos show a large office machine wrapped in clear plastic, likely a photocopier or laser printer.
The machine has a beige or off-white casing with visible branding and model text.
The machine is stacked on top of other similar units, suggesting a bulk or resale lot.
The plastic wrap is crinkled and shows signs of handling, with some creases and smudges.
No power cord, paper tray, or control panel is visible in any photo.
The machine appears to be in a warehouse or storage area, with wooden pallets visible in the background.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: No photo shows the machine's control panel, paper tray, or any interface. The claim about 'superb performance functions' cannot be verified from the photos alone.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powering on, printing a test page, and operating the control panel.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential components such as the power cord, paper tray, or toner cartridge.
risks.proof: Photos of the machine's front, side, and top showing all included parts, including the power cord and paper tray.

risks.risk: The machine may be used or refurbished, not new as implied by 'London use' and 'packed with superb performance functions'.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the machine's serial number or a receipt showing purchase date and location.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and printing a test page.
Photos of the machine's front, side, and top showing all included parts, including power cord and paper tray.
Close-up photo of the machine's serial number or a receipt showing purchase details.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
